hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Any characters can be swapped across any words. The total pool of characters is fixed.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Count character frequencies across all words and calculate the total number of identical pairs: sum(count // 2).

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Sort word lengths in ascending order. To form a palindrome of length L, we need L // 2 matching pairs.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter

class Solution:
    def maxPalindromesAfterOperations(self, words: list[str]) -> int:
        cnt = Counter(''.join(words))
        pairs = sum(c // 2 for c in cnt.values())
        lengths = sorted(len(w) for w in words)
        ans = 0
        for l in lengths:
            need = l // 2
            if pairs >= need:
                pairs -= need
                ans += 1
            else:
                break
        return ans
```

variables: N: total characters across all words
complexity.notes: Global frequency pool count followed by greedy shortest length fulfillment.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying words in non-optimal length order wastes character pairs on long words.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that sorting target lengths ascending maximizes completed palindromes.
